overall_assessment: Reviewed all text and removal spans supplied for 20 suspects and 8 random controls, with five plans capped by the packet. The phone flag matched the attachment ID 32539747 in a reading-list URL, and the name_like flags picked up titles, organisations, cited authors and people discussed as course subject matter, with no confirmed personal data left in the displayed plans. Semester headers and the staff names shown in the removal spans were stripped, but some English scheduling dates and one lecture time survived and one staff-name removal left an unfinished sentence, all in suspects.

findings.evidence: Preparation of Literature review/theoretical framing by April 30, 2026
findings.description: Apparatus Reading retains four dated assignment and presentation entries, including a repeated January deadline and a May date without a comma. Designing Research Methods also retains the 6 November date for a specific AHO Colloquium session. These dates describe course scheduling and none triggered the admin_date pre-pass.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In R/anonymize.R, the generic long-form scheduling rules expect labels such as 'deadline' or 'course dates' and day-before-month dates. They have no matching context for dates attached directly to prose assignment and session entries. The packet pre-pass also lacks these English date forms.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognise English month-day-year with an optional comma on assignment, submission and presentation lines. Match comma-delimited day-month dates attached to named course sessions, such as an AHO Colloquium session, with the existing content-date guard. Strip the date and its introducer while retaining the activity or deliverable, and flag the same contexts in the pre-pass.

findings.evidence: Forelesning fra 9-12 hver mandag formiddagi auditoriet på KHIO.
findings.description: The weekly lecture's 9-to-12 clock range survives in the teaching section. The weekday and morning context identify the range as a clock time under the rubric.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The clock rules in .anon_generic() use minute fields, explicit clock markers or AM/PM in their start patterns. The bare-hour range before a weekday falls outside these patterns.
findings.suggested_fix: In teaching schedule text, remove 'fra' and a dash-separated pair of valid bare hours when followed by 'hver' and a weekday. Keep the weekday and venue and cover examples of week ranges and numeric scales in regression tests.

findings.evidence: Kurset holdes sammen med studenter fra KHIO og foreleser og kursansvarlig er.
findings.description: The name was removed from a coordinated prose clause, leaving the incomplete phrase 'og foreleser og kursansvarlig er.' inside a teaching paragraph.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The generic inline role matcher replaces a role-and-name span with its captured role phrase, including 'er' in this case. The capture is preserved inside a full sentence without a grammatical completion.
findings.suggested_fix: Before generic inline role removal, match the sentence-final staff attribution 'og foreleser og kursansvarlig er <name>' and remove the entire attribution. Keep the sentence-ending punctuation and the preceding information about joint teaching with KHIO students.
